en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ismail Bin Sa’ad Al Ashary who said,

‘I asked Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> about the man who touches the private part of a girl until the water descends from without him (any other) physical contact, (just) playing with her by his hand until he discharges’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When she discharges from the excitement, so the washing is upon her’.
en.sarwar: 5. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Tsma‘il ibn Sa‘d al-Ash’ariy who has said the following: “I once asked al-Rida, Alayhi al-Salam, about a man who touches and plays by his hand with the private parts of his slave-girl without contact of his private part until she feels discharge, is Ghusl (bath) necessary on her?
He (the Imam) said, ‘Ghusl (bath) is necessary if discharge is accompanied by orgasm.’”
